CommunityApplications.Profile: Open-source projects from Oratorian. Emby Watch Party lets friends watch together in sync while the media server stays on the local network. The emby-watchparty template stays on stable 2.x for Emby; emby-watchparty-3 targets stable 3.x with Emby and Jellyfin support. Guests join without media-server accounts, and each viewer has their own proxied HLS stream. For support, please use the linked Unraid forum thread or open an issue on GitHub.
